article.body:
VisTacAlign: Researchers at Stanford's ARMLab propose a method for co-training dexterous policies on tactile human and robot demonstrations (VisTacAlign). The goal is to improve robotic manipulation through shared learning from human demonstrations. The research, published on arXiv, is currently under review. No commercial deployment or independent verification has been reported.

Cybflight: A new embedded Rust autopilot for aerial robotics research is presented in a paper on arXiv. The autopilot, named Cybflight, aims to improve robot navigation and perception. The paper provides no details on commercial deployment or independent verification.
